title: Ledger Nano X from MediaMarkt (first device)

purchase.dateNote: "Recently", before 12 Oct 2026, in Europe. The store location wasn't given.

components: Printed antenna inside the case, marked AC-A2205-NANO-X 欧亚版-V1.0, with a coax lead
Red jumper wires from the Nano X board to a small board on the battery
Replacement battery: MB 281544, 3.7 V 130 mAh 0.481 Wh, dated 2026-04-03
Cellular module, IMEI 867593081451169 and module serial M004J1406AD0603, from the Data Matrix code on its label
implant.notes: The buyer, Johannes (@0xJohannes_), found extra wires, a printed antenna in the case and what he calls an LTE module. He says the device passed Ledger's genuine check, and that he sent it to Mark Karpelès (@MagicalTux) for analysis. Johannes's original post was not located. The clearest photos come from a repost by @CryptosR_Us. The antenna marking follows the same AC-A2xxx scheme as the Flex (AC-A2201-FLEX) and Nano X (AC-A2016-NANO) antennas in other reports. The IMEI was decoded from the Data Matrix code on the module, in the right half of Johannes's annotated photo. Its check digit is valid. The left half of that photo is this device; the post doesn't say whether the right half is this device or the second one. The IMEI's TAC, 86759308, couldn't be matched to a manufacturer from public sources.

sources.author: CryptosRus
sources.text:
ALERT: The Ledger implant scare may have reached Europe. ⚠️

X user Johannes (4, 4) says he found a hardware implant in a Ledger Nano X he recently bought at MediaMarkt. He says it passed Ledger's checks, but his funds weren't touched.

sources.author: Johannes
sources.text: UPDATE: I can confirm that the Ledger supply chain is compromised in Europe as well. […] I just purchased a second device from a different Mediamarkt location today […] Store records show the inventory originated from Aqipa GmbH. […] I sent the first ledger to mark and the second one is going to ledger now, so that they can analyse it.

images.caption: Opened device: red jumper wires run from the Nano X board to a small board on the replacement 130 mAh battery (dated 2026-04-03). The printed antenna in the case end is marked AC-A2205-NANO-X 欧亚版-V1.0.
Johannes's annotated photos: the extra wires and antenna (left), and the board he identifies as the LTE module (right). The module's Data Matrix code decodes to IMEI 867593081451169.
Ledger Nano X boxes on sale in a MediaMarkt store, inside theft-protection cases. The packaging is in German.

Also in the repost: a Nano X taken apart, with a black board and a Dongguan Bimo 100 mAh battery dated 2020-07-17. The post doesn't say which device this is. It looks like an unmodified unit for comparison.
